witness.recorder: DirectoryWitness over a decoy laid out like the operator's root, driven by two real filesystem writes

armedBy: Sabotage 3: the sweep stops descending, options [.skipsSubdirectoryDescendants]. 'Expectation failed: (changed -> []) == ["policy/policy.json"]'. That is exactly how a recursive reader fails silently — it keeps reporting zero for the operator's root for ever because it never looks inside policy/ or audit/ — and it is why this case exists. Sabotage 4 (changed() dead) reds it too. Restored, green.
